sentences.text: No, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on this floating rate business loan to an MSE when the sanctioned amount is ₹40 lakh and the sanction date is 15 March 2026.

The applicable direction covers floating rate loans granted for business purpose to Micro and Small Enterprises, and for a Tier 3 UCB it says no pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh.
The earlier pre-payment-charge directions were superseded and are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
